ahr_methodology.hypothesize: generates Lean4 translations, theorem clusters, imports, and proof scripts
ahr_methodology.observe: records target question, original formal statement, src header excerpt, symbols, and Lean parse errors
ahr_methodology.rank: orders attempts by retrieval score, target-symbol overlap, import cost, tactic cost, and optional learned v3.3 attempt-ranker score
ahr_methodology.refine: records failed attempts and failure buckets for next bridge iteration
ahr_methodology.verify: accepts only Lean-verified target theorem proofs
